objective.jobToBeDone: Generate an AI-assisted status report for a project period, then review, edit, and advance the report through its lifecycle (draft → reviewed → shared with client).
objective.primaryDecision: Whether the generated report content is accurate and complete enough to share with the client — driving the edit-then-transition flow.
decisiveInfo: summary, tasksOverview, timeLogsOverview, materialsOverview, delayRiskAssessment, pmNotes (editable AI-generated content)
objective.usageFrequency: Occasional — triggered per project reporting cycle; the PM works through the full generate → review → share sequence in one focused session.

criticalActions.presentation: primary-button inside a compact generation panel; projectId is context-derived (hidden), only period dates are user inputs
inline rich-text editor sections within the report detail panel; save is a persistent footer action
contextual-transition-actions — one button per valid next state (Mark Reviewed, Share with Client) rendered in the report header, never a free status select

informationHierarchy: 1. Report generation panel — project context + period picker + Generate action
2. Generated report detail — current status badge, period, generatedAt timestamp
3. Editable content sections — summary, tasks overview, time logs overview, materials overview, delay risk assessment, PM notes
4. Lifecycle transition actions — Mark Reviewed / Share with Client buttons based on current status
objective.successCriteria: The PM can generate a report, review and refine all AI-produced sections in one place, and advance the report to 'shared' without navigating away or manually typing any system-owned identifier.
antiPatterns: Exposing statusReportId as a manual text input
Rendering status transition as a free <select> over all enum values
Splitting generate and review into entirely separate pages with no continuity
Showing system-owned fields (generatedAt, createdAt, updatedAt) as editable inputs
Requiring the PM to re-enter projectId after it is already in context
